# CareNest AI — Full Technical Specification for Autonomous AI Agents

## Overview
CareNest AI is an open-source geriatric healthcare and medication adherence web application.

## System Architecture
- Frontend: React 19, TypeScript (strict mode), Tailwind CSS v4, Lucide Icons, Radix UI primitives.
- Routing: TanStack Router.
- State & Telemetry: LocalStorage persistence with real-time biometric feeds (BP, Blood Sugar, Pulse, SpO2).
- AI Engine: Google Gemini 2.5 Flash API for geriatric medication instruction simplification and multi-drug interaction safety analysis.
- Audio Engine: Web Speech API with sub-10ms localized fallback templates for instant speech synthesis.

## User Roles
1. Senior / Elder: Interacts via voice commands or high-contrast tactile cards with affectionate honorifics (Amma, Appa).
2. Family Caregiver: Monitors routine completion, receives email alerts, and manages refill schedules.
3. Attending Physician: Reviews vital signs, adjusts drug dosages, and initiates WebRTC telehealth consultations.

## Agent Guidelines for Automated Browsing
- Root URL: https://catalyst-hackathon-lime.vercel.app/
- Senior Mode is default active.
- To switch to Caretaker Dashboard: Click 'Caregiver Portal' button and enter passcode 'CARE-8492'.
- To reset routine to pending: Click 'Reset Routine'.
